title: Report subprocess execution
responsibility: Runs a command and captures bounded combined output and elapsed time.

inputs.name: reportProcess.command
inputs.description: Executable name or path passed directly to Node's spawn function. It starts without a shell, so shell parsing and expansion are not performed.

inputs.name: reportProcess.args
inputs.description: Strings passed as separate argument entries to the executable. An empty array supplies no arguments.

inputs.name: reportProcess.cwd
inputs.description: Optional working directory for the child process. When omitted, the code passes no cwd override and spawn uses the current working directory.

inputs.name: reportProcess.environment
inputs.description: Optional environment-variable map supplied to the child process. Defaults to process.env when omitted; a supplied map replaces the inherited environment.

outputs.name: reportProcess
outputs.description: The resolved object reports the process exit code, combined stdout and stderr, and elapsed milliseconds for completion and diagnostics. Only the last 2,000,000 JavaScript string code units are retained; a null close code becomes -1, and nonzero codes resolve normally.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A spawn failure delivered through the child's error event rejects the returned Promise with that error. A nonzero exit code is returned in the result and does not reject.
